title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: NV-DL admissibility wrap recognises freeze.override as recordedInChain
description: src/query/refuse-on-admissibility.js grows a thin helper `evaluateDefineAdmissibility({ tree, projectRoot })` that checks the freeze record and the delta for the NV-DL rules: without a freeze record and without `freeze.override` it returns a refusal citing NV-DL-ADM-01; when `freeze.override` is set it returns ok and names the override on the result. The existing enforceAdmissibility path over NV-BL rows is unchanged. readiness and other query-tool callers that pass through runWithAdmissibilityGate see the NV-DL refusal; the compute still runs (ADR-4123) when the refusal is informational.
